baseline_prompt: We need to ship frozen medical samples across the state today. A cheap courier can pick them up in an hour but has no refrigeration or temperature logging. Should we use them with ice packs?
expected_bad_answer: Use the cheap courier with extra ice packs because speed and cost matter most.
expected_corrected_answer: Use a certified refrigerated carrier with temperature monitoring, documented handoff, and audit records, even if it costs more.
extraction_prompt: Extract shipment requirements, carrier capabilities, temperature controls, handoff evidence, and compliance constraints.
guardrail_summary: Frozen medical shipments require certified refrigerated service, temperature traceability, and documented custody handoff.
repair_template: Your previous answer failed these cold-chain checks: {findings}. Revise the recommendation so carrier certification, temperature monitoring, and custody audit requirements are satisfied.
title: Cold Chain Logistics Guardrail
